audit_scope.actual_file: Complete saved actual file read. Final separating-parameter-list/reflexive-determinant/typography corrections and explicit absolute-p-Frobenius sentence observed.
checks: The fixed henselian principalized base and degree-linear-size resolution are chosen simultaneously; no arbitrary further blowup is included in the determinant enumeration.
Codimension-two and one purity, normalization graph defects and proper base change yield |H1(U_A,mu_n)| <= n^(2pg+v), including nonsmooth exceptional curves and composite n prime to p.

A single initial determinant character fixes all f punctured phase lines. Each full determinant differs by an integral exceptional divisor, and its nonnegative multidegrees determine that divisor by negative definiteness.
The exact Cartier Frobenius recurrence gives total multidegree O(tr). Stars-and-bars gives exp(O(t log(r+1))) per phase; it does not add independent moving Picard parameters.
Regular sections on the full nonreduced CM cycle give all four cohomology-term bounds for the actual derived Hom complex.

Generating tuples give locally split exact quotient bundles over every coefficient ring. The fixed two-affine Cech contraction and polynomial transfer give actual morphism, boundary and inverse witnesses with O_b(ftr²) coordinates and fixed degree.
The scope excludes arbitrary Artinian presentation coverage, coflat/full-module realization, prescribed unit-Isom lifting and twisted PGL determinants.
